title: Orders of reaction and parameters from data

segs.text: Module one, objective four. Orders of reaction, and parameters from a data set. In a zero order process the same amount of drug is lost every hour, however much is left. In a first order process the same fraction is lost every hour, so more is lost per hour when more drug is present. When a stem says I V bolus, a single dose injected into a vein all at once, assume first order. When it gives a data table, you decide the order yourself.

card.m: zero order: same amount lost per hour
first order: same fraction lost per hour

segs.text: For zero order, d C by d t equals minus k, and C equals C zero minus k t. That k is in milligrams per milliliter per hour, and the line is straight on linear axes. For first order, d C by d t equals minus k C, so the rate depends on the concentration present. Then C equals C zero times e to the minus k t, and the natural log of C equals the natural log of C zero minus k t. That k is in per hour, so k t has no units, and the line is straight on a semilog axis. Axis marks of one, ten, one hundred and one thousand mean a log scale, labelled or not.

card.m: k in (mg/mL)/hr; straight on linear axes
C = C<sub>0</sub>e<sup>−kt</sup>   ln C = ln C<sub>0</sub> − kt
k in hr<sup>−1</sup>; straight on a semilog axis

segs.text: Her practice set: a solution sampled at two, six, twelve, twenty four, thirty six and forty eight hours gave two hundred ninety four point three, two hundred eight point one, one hundred twenty three point eight, forty three point eight, fifteen point five and five point five milligrams per liter. It asks for k, C zero, the half-life and the time to ninety percent decomposed. Equal ratios over equal time spans mean first order, and equal differences per hour mean zero order. From twelve to twenty four hours, one hundred twenty three point eight over forty three point eight is two point eight three. From twenty four to thirty six hours, forty three point eight over fifteen point five is two point eight three. Equal ratios, so first order.

card.m: find k, C<sub>0</sub>, t<sub>½</sub>, time to 90% decomposed
equal ratios: first   equal differences: zero

segs.text: For k, take the six hour and twenty four hour points. The first order line is k equals the natural log of C one minus the natural log of C two, over t two minus t one, with C one the earlier point so that k comes out positive. The natural log of two hundred eight point one is five point three three eight zero, and the natural log of forty three point eight is three point seven seven nine six. The difference, one point five five eight four, is divided by twenty four minus six, eighteen hours. That gives zero point zero eight six five eight, so k is zero point zero eight six six per hour, because the logs have no units and the bottom is in hours.

Next, C zero, worked back from the twelve hour point. For first order, C zero equals C times e to the plus k t. The sign is plus because C zero must be larger than any later concentration. k t is zero point zero eight six six per hour times twelve hours, which is one point zero three nine two, with no units. e to the one point zero three nine two is two point eight two seven. One hundred twenty three point eight times two point eight two seven is three hundred forty nine point nine eight, so C zero is three hundred fifty milligrams per liter.

The first order half-life is zero point six nine three over k. Zero point six nine three over zero point zero eight six six per hour is eight point zero zero two, so eight hours. She said, I expect you to give me half-life in units of time. For ninety percent decomposed, ten percent remains, so C is one tenth of C zero. The time to fall to C is the natural log of C zero minus the natural log of C, over k, so C zero cancels and the time is the natural log of ten over k. That is two point three zero two six over zero point zero eight six six per hour, twenty six point five eight nine, so twenty six point six hours.

Where the percentage lost is a power of one half, count half-lives instead. One half-life leaves fifty percent, two leave twenty five, and three leave twelve point five. With an eight hour half-life, seven hundred fifty milligrams decomposing by eighty seven point five percent takes three half-lives, twenty four hours, and the seven hundred fifty milligrams is not needed. Her true or false items pair rate with half-life. First order: the rate changes with concentration, and the half-life is constant. Zero order: the rate is constant, and the half-life depends on C zero.

card.m: zero: rate constant, t<sub>½</sub> depends on C<sub>0</sub>

segs.text: The same stem with a zero order table, at the same six times: three hundred thirty eight, three hundred fourteen, two hundred seventy eight, two hundred six, one hundred thirty four and sixty two milligrams per milliliter. Three hundred thirty eight minus three hundred fourteen is twenty four milligrams per milliliter in four hours, and three hundred fourteen minus two hundred seventy eight is thirty six in six hours. Both are six per hour, so zero order. For zero order, k equals C one minus C two, over t two minus t one. From the two and twenty four hour points, three hundred thirty eight minus two hundred six is one hundred thirty two milligrams per milliliter, over twenty two hours, so k is six milligrams per milliliter per hour.

card.m: 338 − 314 = 24 mg/mL in 4 hr   314 − 278 = 36 mg/mL in 6 hr

segs.text: Working back, C zero equals C plus k t: three hundred thirty eight plus six times two, three hundred fifty milligrams per milliliter. The zero order half-life is C zero over two k. It comes from C equals C zero minus k t with C set to half of C zero, so a lower starting concentration gives a shorter half-life. Here it is three hundred fifty over two times six, which is three hundred fifty over twelve, twenty nine point one seven, so twenty nine point two hours, because milligrams per milliliter cancel. For ninety percent decomposed, ten percent of three hundred fifty is thirty five milligrams per milliliter. The time is three hundred fifty minus thirty five, over six: three hundred fifteen over six, fifty two point five hours.
